title: Riot X Nic Salts Morello Cherry Banana 10ml E-Liquid
description: Morello Cherry Banana from Riot X is a rich and intriguing fruit blend that combines the deep, unctuous notes of rich and juicy Morello cherries with the smooth, creamy sweetness of ripe banana. The contrast between the slightly tart cherry and the mellow, tropical banana creates a beautifully layered, well-rounded vape with a satisfying balance of bold and mellow fruit flavours. Part of Riot Squad’s Riot X collection, this e-liquid is designed to replicate the intense, double-concentrated flavours found in the most popular single-use disposables. Supplied in a 10ml bottle, it’s an excellent choice for vapers transitioning from disposables to refillable MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits, providing the same vibrant taste with the added benefits of convenience and cost savings that such kit and e-liquid setups offer. Riot X Salt E-Liquids are made with Riot Squad’s Hybrid Nicotine blend, a combination of freebase nicotine and nicotine salts. This innovative mix, along with the 50PG/50VG ratio, ensures a well-balanced vape with rich flavour, a smooth throat hit, and satisfying vapour production. Please note: this flavour profile may contain hints of 'ice'.
